_doc: Alert rules. Severities: info (blue), warn (yellow), critical (red). persist_s = how long (wall seconds) a condition must hold before the alert shows; state confirmation already adds one read (~2 s). Edit and restart the overlay to apply; use `aoe4ov replay` to test against a recorded session.

floating._doc: One stockpile limit per age (I, II, III; the last also applies to Age IV). Above the current age's limit = info; above the next age's = warn; two ages ahead = critical.

sound._doc: Sound of each severity, by name from assets/sounds/library (empty = silent). `aoe4ov sounds` lists and previews them. Severities in `repeat` play again every repeat_s while unresolved. volume 0-1. Restart the overlay to apply.
